sections.title: Punishment for Murder
sections.text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine. Sub-clause (2) explicitly penalizes group murder / mob lynching.

sections.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
sections.text: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces person deceived to deliver property, or alter valuable security, shall be punished with imprisonment up to seven years and fine.

sections.title: Punishment for Rape
sections.text: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than ten years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and fine.

sections.title: When police may arrest without warrant
sections.text: Any police officer may without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant arrest any person who commits in the presence of a police officer a cognizable offence.

sections.title: Information in cognizable cases (Registration of FIR)
sections.text: Every information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence, if given orally to an officer in charge of a police station, shall be reduced to writing. Mandatory provision for Zero FIR and electronic FIR.

sections.title: When bail may be taken in case of non-bailable offence
sections.text: When any person accused of, or suspected of, the commission of any non-bailable offence is arrested or detained without warrant, or appears before a court, he may be released on bail.

sections.title: Admissibility of electronic or digital records as evidence
sections.text: Nothing in this Adhiniyam shall apply to electronic records unless certified. Electronic evidence carries same legal sanctity as paper documents when accompanied by Section 63 certificate.

sections.title: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, etc.
sections.text: All citizens shall have the right: (a) to freedom of speech and expression; (b) to assemble peaceably and without arms; (c) to form associations or unions; (d) to move freely throughout India.

sections.title: Protection of life and personal liberty
sections.text: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

sections.title: Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases
sections.text: No person who is arrested shall be detained in custody without being informed of grounds, nor denied right to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of choice. Production within 24 hours.

sections.title: Unfair trade practice
sections.text: A trade practice which, for the purpose of promoting sale, use or supply of goods or services, adopts any unfair method or deceptive practice including false representation, misleading warranty, or refusal to issue tax invoice.
